id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

isAppLoading.description: Indicates if the application is loading and the UI should show an overlay with a spinner.

projectSettings.description: Project settings (ie: default and tutorial project)

uiSettings.description: UI Settings dependent on the backend configuration

userSettings.description: User Settings for the application (ie: active project for the user)

generativeAiResult.description:
The result of sending the query string to the Generative AI model. Fills out answer, rationale,
and sources in the UI

queryResultHistoryCache.description:
A representation of historical modififications to query results. This is specific to the scenario where a user
uses a UI feature, such as the Eval Spec Popover, to make a modification to a query result and apply changes.
A query result will only appear in this map if it was the result of such a modification.

queryString.description: The most recent query string the User has input

selectedEntityId.description: An entity id selected from a component in the UI

selectedPassageId.description: A passage relation id selected from the search results grid

selectedDocument.description: A source file selected from the Documents grid

sourceMetadataFields.description: Filterable metadata fields for the app instance

sourceMetadataValues.description: All metadata values associated with the fields in #sourceMetadataFields

disableChat.description: Whether the chat input should be disabled

disableChatInput.description: Whether the full chat input should be disabled

disableSearch.description: Whether the chat input should be disabled

disableToolSelector.description: Whether the query tool selector should be disabled

hideFilterApply.description: Whether to hide the 'Apply' button in the filters bar

readOnlyConfig.description: Set of feature configuration values that are read-only to the user.

syncScheduleOptions.description: The saved options for document syncing.

subscriptionPlan.description:
Whether or not the current application is in a free trial state.
This is a value of type Genai.Billing.SubscriptionPlan. It is set to any because Genai.Billing.SubscriptionPlan is not in this package.
ONLY USED IN SELF SERVICE APPLICATIONS

storedCollectionFiles.description: Files fetched from the selected collection while uploading documents

selectedTagType.description: A category tag type selected from the TagsGrid

queryToolOptionsLoading.description: Whether the query tool options are currently loading. This allows us to delay some UI elements until loaded.

queryToolOptions.description:
The query tool options available to the user. This allows the user to target a specific tool when submitting a
query.

chatQueryMultiToolSelections.description: The query tool options that are currently selected by the user for chat queries when allowMultipleToolSelection is set to true

selectedChatQueryTool.description:
The query tool option that is currently selected by the user for chat queries. Search queries are handled
separately via page params.

typeMetasCache.description: A map of {@link Type#name} to the associated {@link TypeMeta} for quick lookup in the UI.

conversation.description: The current conversation to display. Used in the Conversation Detail Page.

showUnhelpfulSpecNotif.description: Whether to show unhelpful spec notification to user

plannerOptions.description:
The planner options available to the user.
This allows the user to target a specific planner when submitting a query.

selectedPlanner.description: The name of the config of the planner selected by the user.

plannerOptionsLoading.description: Whether the planner options are currently loading. This allows us to delay some UI elements until loaded.

title: {@link UiSdlApplicationState Application} of the Search Advantage application.
